comparisons.openai/codex: test-tui requires interactive PTY use and separate text and Enter writes; this supports the capture harness input boundary and avoids burst ambiguity.
comparisons.PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent: TUI components return width-bounded lines and receive focused input through handleInput; this supports checking every captured frame width and focus behavior.
comparisons.NousResearch/hermes-agent: visual-snapshot forces a fixed viewport before capture and preview-capture rejects empty/destroyed captures; this supports fixed-size evidence and fail-closed capture handling.
comparisons.anomalyco/opencode: visual-stability capture records repeated CDP frames with timestamps, while terminal-composer-focus tests focus routing and explicit terminal/composer boundaries; this supports repeatable capture plus focus-state checks.
